The '''Hypori Droid Factory''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] that threw out thousands of defective droid parts every day during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Its scrap heaps were occasionally raided by scavengers.<ref name="Mission" />
